verses.en: For the Leader; for Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.

verses.he: אַ֣ךְ אֶל־אֱ֭לֹהִים דּֽוּמִיָּ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃
verses.en: Only for God doth my soul wait in stillness; From Him cometh my salvation.

verses.he: אַךְ־ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִי וִֽישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹא־אֶמּ֥וֹט רַבָּֽה׃
verses.en: He only is my rock and my salvation, My high tower, I shall not be greatly moved.

verses.he: עַד־אָ֤נָה׀ תְּהֽוֹתְת֣וּ עַל אִישׁ֮ תְּרָצְּח֪וּ כֻ֫לְּכֶ֥ם כְּקִ֥יר נָט֑וּי גָּ֝דֵ֗ר הַדְּחוּיָֽה׃
verses.en: How long will ye set upon a man, That ye may slay him, all of you, As a leaning wall, a tottering fence?

verses.he: אַ֤ךְ מִשְּׂאֵת֨וֹ׀ יָעֲצ֣וּ לְהַדִּיחַ֮ יִרְצ֪וּ כָ֫זָ֥ב בְּפִ֥יו יְבָרֵ֑כוּ וּ֝בְקִרְבָּ֗ם יְקַלְלוּ־סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: They only devise to thrust him down from his height, delighting in lies; They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah

verses.he: אַ֣ךְ לֵ֭אלֹהִים דּ֣וֹמִּי נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּי־מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תִּקְוָתִֽי׃
verses.en: Only for God wait thou in stillness, my soul; For from Him cometh my hope.

verses.he: אַךְ־ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִי וִֽישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹ֣א אֶמּֽוֹט׃
verses.en: He only is my rock and my salvation, My high tower, I shall not be moved.

verses.he: עַל־אֱ֭לֹהִים יִשְׁעִ֣י וּכְבוֹדִ֑י צוּר־עֻזִּ֥י מַ֝חְסִ֗י בֵּֽאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.en: Upon God resteth my salvation and my glory; The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

verses.he: בִּטְח֘וּ ב֤וֹ בְכָל־עֵ֨ת׀ עָ֗ם שִׁפְכֽוּ־לְפָנָ֥יו לְבַבְכֶ֑ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים מַחֲסֶה־לָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: Trust in Him at all times, ye people; Pour out your heart before Him; God is a refuge for us. Selah

verses.he: אַ֤ךְ׀ הֶ֥בֶל בְּנֵֽי־אָדָם֮ כָּזָ֪ב בְּנֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ בְּמֹאזְנַ֥יִם לַעֲל֑וֹת הֵ֝֗מָּה מֵהֶ֥בֶל יָֽחַד׃
verses.en: Men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie; If they be laid in the balances, they are together lighter than vanity.

verses.he: אַל־תִּבְטְח֣וּ בְעֹשֶׁק֮ וּבְגָזֵ֪ל אַל־תֶּ֫הְבָּ֥לוּ חַ֤יִל׀ כִּֽי־יָנ֑וּב אַל־תָּשִׁ֥יתוּ לֵֽב׃
verses.en: Trust not in oppression, And put not vain hope in robbery; If riches increase, set not your heart thereon.

verses.he: אַחַ֤ת׀ דִּבֶּ֬ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים שְׁתַּֽיִם־ז֥וּ שָׁמָ֑עְתִּי כִּ֥י עֹ֝֗ז לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.en: God hath spoken once, Twice have I heard this: That strength belongeth unto God;

verses.he: וּלְךָֽ־אֲדֹנָ֥י חָ֑סֶד כִּֽי־אַתָּ֨ה תְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּֽמַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
verses.en: Also unto Thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy; For Thou renderest to every man according to his work.
